# xAI — Style Reference

> Black ink on bond paper, every color sealed under glass slides. A 450-weight variable grotesk on #ffffff, translucent-ink hairlines at 6% opacity, and one ember-orange tag that says "New" quietly instead of shouting it.

**Theme:** light

Values are measured from the live site and normalized; names, roles and recommendations are interpretation. Font lists are independent, not paired by position. Example prompts describe reconstructions, not the site's source code.

xAI speaks a quarantined-color laboratory language. The chrome is ink on paper, and every saturated hue lives inside a product mockup. The canvas is #ffffff. Product and plan tiles step up to a warm #f9f8f6, secondary pills sit on a 4% ink wash (#0a0a0a0a), and the only inverted surface is the #151515 terminal tile. The interface has a chromatic budget of exactly one hue, Ember #ff6308, and it appears in two places only: a 10% tint behind the "New" tag and a decorative gradient field behind the code window. Terminal syntax, traffic lights and photography are mockup-internal. Typography runs on one variable grotesk, xVf, at weights 400, 450 and 500, with tracking pinned at −1% on every size from 16px up. The 60px headline sits at the in-between weight 450, and the 48→60 step is a Major Third, so size carries hierarchy rather than boldness. Shapes are binary: 9999px pills for anything clickable, 16px for containers. Elevation is tonal, and shadows are reserved for the two floating layers. The page reads as a research instrument rather than a marketing site.

## Tokens — Colors

| Name | Value | Token | Role |

| Paper Canvas | `#ffffff` | `--color-paper-canvas` | Body background, the code-window panel and the mega-menu sheet. Pure white, deliberately not warmed — the warmth is saved for the tiles that sit on it. |
| Linen Tile | `#f9f8f6` | `--color-linen-tile` | Chat, Bot and Voice product tiles and both plan cards (11 uses). A 1.5% warm step that separates containers without borders or shadow — the workhorse surface. |
| Fog Wash | `#0a0a0a0a` | `--color-fog-wash` | Secondary pill fill, chat bubbles and the Contact Sales nav pill (12 uses). Translucent ink, so it reads cooler on white and warmer on Linen. Do not use it as a section background. |
| Mist Wash | `#0a0a0a14` | `--color-mist-wash` | Active language tab, the announcement-pill border and the outline-pill stroke (13 uses). The second and final wash step — a heavier ink veil for selected or pressed states. |
| Onyx Terminal | `#151515` | `--color-onyx-terminal` | The Build terminal tile and dark mockup chrome. This is the one inverted surface — it appears as a product screenshot rather than a page section. |
| Ink | `#0a0a0a` | `--color-ink` | All headings, body copy, nav links and the primary pill fill (175+ text uses). An off-black that is softer than #000 and carries the full brand weight of the CTA. |
| Stone Ink | `#59534d` | `--color-stone-ink` | Warm secondary copy in tile labels and footer support lines (8 uses). A brown-grey that keeps de-emphasized text in the Linen temperature family. |
| Graphite Caption | `#0a0a0a99` | `--color-graphite-caption` | Eyebrows such as "For developers", copy-button labels and meta lines (7 uses). Ink at 60% so it tints correctly on any surface. |
| Steel Tab | `#7d8187` | `--color-steel-tab` | Inactive language tabs (TypeScript, cURL) and other unselected toggles. A cool grey reserved for inactive state. Do not use it for paragraph text. |
| Pebble Caption | `#8d867e` | `--color-pebble-caption` | Stat labels ("API calls per day"), news dates and the lightest metadata (14 uses). This is the floor of the warm text ramp. |
| Ash Hairline | `#0a0a0a0f` | `--color-ash-hairline` | Stat-row rules, section dividers and plan-card separators (6 uses). A 6% ink line that registers as structure without reading as a frame. |
| Ember Signal | `#ff6308` | `--color-ember-signal` | Text of the "New" tag and the hue of the decorative gradient field behind the code window. This is the entire chromatic budget of the chrome. Do not promote it to the primary CTA color. |
| Ember Tint | `#ff63081a` | `--color-ember-tint` | Background of the "New" tag inside the announcement pill (1 use). Ember at 10% opacity — the only place orange touches a UI fill. |

## Tokens — Typography

### xVf — custom variable grotesk carrying display, headings, UI and body · `--font-xvf`

- **Substitute:** Inter Variable at 450 for display and 400/500 elsewhere; Geist at 450 for display and 400/500 elsewhere; Instrument Sans at 450. xVf draws true to its nominal weight with a slightly open, low-contrast stroke. Its 450 renders like a crisp book weight, not a medium, so do not round the display weight up to 500.
- **Weights:** 400, 450, 500
- **Sizes:** 10px, 10.5px, 11px, 12px, 13px, 14px, 16px, 18px, 24px, 30px, 48px, 60px
- **Line height:** 1.0 (48px, 60px), 1.2 (30px), 1.333 (12px, 24px), 1.375 (16px titles), 1.43 (14px), 1.5 (10px), 1.625 (10.5px, 13px, 16px, 18px running text)
- **Letter spacing:** −0.6px at 60px, −0.48px at 48px, −0.3px at 30px, −0.24px at 24px, −0.16px at 16px weight 500; 0 at 10.5–18px weight 400; +0.5px at 10px uppercase
- **Role:** One family does every job, and three weights only 50 units apart do the work that other sites spread across 400 to 700. Weight 450 on the 60px H1 is the signature: lighter than the 500 used on 48px and 30px section heads, so the biggest type on the page is also the quietest. Tracking is a uniform −1% of size on everything 16px and up. That is a proportional rule rather than the conventional hand-tuned ramp, and it keeps display lines tight without crushing them. The 48→60 step is a textbook Major Third (1.25), and 24→30 repeats the same ratio.

### GeistMono — technical voice for code, terminals and data · `--font-geist-mono`

- **Substitute:** Geist Mono at 400 (the open-source original); JetBrains Mono at 400; IBM Plex Mono at 400. Geist Mono's 400 is a medium-light monoline, and Plex Mono at 400 reads a hair heavier, which is acceptable at 11–13px.
- **Weights:** 400, 700
- **Sizes:** 10px, 11px, 12px, 13px
- **Line height:** 1.583 (12px), 1.6 (10px), 1.625 (11px), 1.846 (13px code)
- **Letter spacing:** −0.1px at 10px, −0.11px at 11px, −0.12px at 12px, 0 at 13px
- **Role:** The second most-used family (99 uses) appears only inside product surfaces: the terminal tile, the Python sample and status brackets like `[running]`. The −1% tracking mirrors xVf's display rule at micro scale, so the two families share one spacing logic. The 1.846 line height on 13px code is deliberately airier than the conventional 1.5 for code blocks, which makes the sample read as a typeset exhibit rather than a dump.

### system-ui — native UI text inside chat mockups · `--font-system-ui`

- **Substitute:** Inter at 400 and 600; Roboto at 400 and 500. Native SF and Segoe draw true to weight, so match the numbers directly.
- **Weights:** 400, 600
- **Sizes:** 13px, 14px
- **Line height:** 1.231 (13px), 1.43 (14px)
- **Letter spacing:** −0.15px at 14px, 0 at 13px
- **Role:** Twelve uses, all inside the chat and Bot mockups. The site renders its product screens in the operating system's own face so they read as real app captures rather than illustrations. It is mockup-internal and must stay out of marketing copy.

### Type Scale

| Role | Family | Weight | Size | Line Height | Letter Spacing | Token |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| small | xVf | 500 | 10px | 1.5 | 0.5px | `--text-small` |
| caption | xVf | 400 | 12px | 1.333 | 0px | `--text-caption` |
| body-sm | xVf | 400 | 13px | 1.625 | 0px | `--text-body-sm` |
| body | xVf | — | 14px | 1.43 | 0px | `--text-body` |
| body-lg | xVf | 400 | 16px | 1.625 | 0px | `--text-body-lg` |
| subheading | xVf | 400 | 18px | 1.625 | 0px | `--text-subheading` |
| heading-sm | xVf | 500 | 24px | 1.333 | -0.24px | `--text-heading-sm` |
| heading | xVf | 500 | 30px | 1.2 | -0.3px | `--text-heading` |
| heading-lg | xVf | 500 | 48px | 1.0 | -0.48px | `--text-heading-lg` |
| display | xVf | 450 | 60px | 1.0 | -0.6px | `--text-display` |

## Do's and Don'ts

### Do

- Set the hero headline in xVf weight 450 at 60px with −0.6px tracking and line-height 1.0 — the in-between weight is the signature, making the largest type the calmest element on screen.
- Keep every clickable control a 9999px pill and every container a 16px rectangle — the binary shape vocabulary tells the user what is action and what is frame without color.
- Fill the primary action with #0a0a0a and white 14px weight 500 text — off-black is the brand color here, and its contrast replaces a saturated CTA.
- Pair each Ink pill with a Fog Wash #0a0a0a0a pill at an 8px gap — the two-density pair is the standard action group in the hero, the API section and the nav.
- Separate surfaces by tone: #ffffff canvas, #f9f8f6 tiles, #151515 terminal — layering by temperature and value keeps shadows free for the two floating layers.
- Apply −1% tracking (−0.01em) to every xVf size from 16px to 60px — a proportional rule rather than a hand-tuned ramp, so new sizes inherit the system automatically.
- Confine saturated hues to the product interior: syntax highlighting, traffic lights, photography and the #ff6308 gradient field. Keeping the chrome achromatic is non-negotiable, because the mockups are the exhibits and the page is the gallery wall.

### Don't

- Don't bump the 60px headline to weight 600 or 700 out of habit — conventional SaaS heroes go bold, but here heaviness would flatten the quiet 450-to-500 ladder that carries hierarchy.
- Don't recolor the primary pill in #ff6308 because Ember is the "brand orange" — doing so spends the one-hue budget on chrome and breaks the rule that color lives only inside product screens.
- Don't wrap Linen tiles in 1px borders or 0 4px 12px shadows — the 1.5% step from #ffffff to #f9f8f6 is the entire separation mechanism, and frames turn the vitrines into widgets.
- Don't swap Fog Wash for an opaque grey like #f2f2f2 — the 4% ink veil must re-tint on Linen and on white, and an opaque fill reads cold against #f9f8f6.
- Don't introduce 8px-radius buttons or 24px-radius cards — the 9999px/16px binary is the shape grammar, and in-between radii blur action and container.
- Don't set paragraph text in GeistMono or system-ui — mono and native faces are reserved for code and mockups at 10–14px, and leaking them into marketing copy collapses the exhibit/frame distinction.
- Don't put a colored icon or gradient behind a stat figure — the 48px #0a0a0a numbers over #8d867e labels must stand on typography alone. Decoration would make the proof read as promotion, so color should never be added there.

## Agent Prompt Guide

**Quick Color Reference**

- canvas: #ffffff (Paper Canvas)
- tile surface: #f9f8f6 (Linen Tile)
- secondary fill: #0a0a0a0a (Fog Wash)
- text: #0a0a0a (Ink)
- caption: #8d867e (Pebble Caption)
- hairline: #0a0a0a0f (Ash Hairline)
- accent: #ff6308 (Ember Signal)
- primary action: #0a0a0a (filled action)

**Color in Data**

Charts stay neutral: draw primary series as solid #0a0a0a and comparison series as #0a0a0a14. Ember #ff6308 is allowed for at most one highlighted data point, and #ff63081a only as a background band, so the accent is the quietest saturated thing on the page rather than the loudest.

**Example Component Prompts**

1. Build a primary action button labeled "Get API Access": an inline-flex `<a>` with background #0a0a0a, text #ffffff, no border, border-radius 9999px, padding 12px 20px, height 44px, font xVf (fallback Inter at 500) 14px weight 500, line-height 1.43, letter-spacing 0, and a 12px chevron-right icon 6px after the label. No shadow. Hover changes the background to #0a0a0a at 90% opacity. Place it 8px left of a secondary pill with background #0a0a0a0a, text #0a0a0a and identical radius, padding and type.

2. Build a centered hero on #ffffff with 148px top padding inside a 1280px container. First, an announcement pill: transparent background, backdrop-filter blur(4px), border 1px solid #0a0a0a14, radius 9999px, padding 6px 6px 6px 10px. It contains a "New" tag in #ff6308 on #ff63081a (radius 3px, padding 2px 6px, 12px weight 500), "Meet Grok 4.7" in 13px weight 500 #0a0a0a, and "· Our new model" in 13px weight 400 #0a0a0a99. Then, 32px below, an H1 at 60px weight 450, line-height 1.0, letter-spacing −0.6px, #0a0a0a, max-width 768px, on two lines. Then, 24px below, a 18px weight 400 subline in #0a0a0a at line-height 1.625. Then, 32px below, the Ink and Fog Wash pill pair.

3. Build a product tile: an `<a>` 403×280px with background #f9f8f6, border-radius 16px, overflow hidden, padding 0, no border, no shadow. Inside, place a chat mockup whose bubbles use background #0a0a0a0a, radius 16px 16px 16px 6px, padding 8px 12px, and system-ui 14px weight 400 with −0.15px tracking. Right-aligned user bubbles are offset 12px from the edge. Pin a footer row 12px from the bottom with 12px side insets: "Chat" in xVf 14px weight 500 #0a0a0a on the left and "Explore →" in the same style on the right. Lay three tiles in a row with a 12px gap.

4. Build a fixed navigation bar 64px tall, background #ffffff, no border, no shadow, content in a 1280px container. Left: a 51px-wide ink logo mark, then links "Products", "Solutions", "Developer", "Company" (each with a 10px chevron) plus "Pricing" and "News", all xVf 13px weight 500 #0a0a0a with padding 6px 12px. Right: a "Contact Sales" pill (background #0a0a0a0a, text #0a0a0a, radius 9999px, padding 10px 18px, 14px weight 500), then 8px later a split ink pill. Its label segment has radius 9999px 0 0 9999px and padding 10px 18px. Its 36×36px chevron segment has radius 0 9999px 9999px 0 and padding 0 12px 0 8px. Both segments use background #0a0a0a and text #ffffff. The chevron opens a #ffffff dropdown with radius 12px, padding 12px and shadow rgba(0,0,0,0.22) 0px 16px 48px -8px.

## Components

### Pill Button — Ink (Primary)

**Role:** Primary conversion action, every section

Solid ink capsule. The spec is background #0a0a0a, text #ffffff, no border, border-radius 9999px, padding 12px 20px for the 44px hero size (10px 18px for the 40px section and card size), xVf 14px weight 500 at line-height 1.43, no shadow, and an optional trailing chevron at a 6px gap. Off-black contrast does the job a brand color does on conventional SaaS pages, and this is the only filled black object in most viewports.

### Pill Button — Fog Wash (Secondary)

**Role:** Documentation and low-commitment paths

Translucent ink capsule. The spec is background #0a0a0a0a, text #0a0a0a, no border, border-radius 9999px, padding 12px 20px (44px) or 10px 18px (40px), and xVf 14px weight 500, with no shadow. It always sits directly right of the Ink pill at an 8px gap. The 4% wash replaces the conventional outlined secondary button, so the pair reads as one object with two densities rather than a filled button and a frame.

### Split Pill Button — Nav "Try for Free"

**Role:** Primary nav action with dropdown

The system outlier. Two ink segments are butted together: a label segment with border-radius 9999px 0 0 9999px, and a 36×36px chevron segment with radius 0 9999px 9999px 0 and padding 0 12px 0 8px. Both use background #0a0a0a, text #ffffff and xVf 14px weight 500. It is the only place a pill is cut in half. The exception is allowed because the chevron opens the mega-menu, so the shape honestly signals two actions inside one capsule.

### Navigation Bar

**Role:** Fixed global wayfinding, 64px

A quiet ink strip. It is fixed at 64px high on a #ffffff background with no bottom border and no shadow. The 51px logo mark in #0a0a0a sits left, followed by six links in xVf 13px weight 500, #0a0a0a, padding 6px 12px, with chevrons on the four menus. Right of those come the Fog Wash "Contact Sales" pill (10px 18px) and the split Ink pill, 8px apart. Links have no underline and no color change, which deliberately matches the achromatic chrome.

### Mega-Menu Dropdown

**Role:** Grouped product and download links

A floating white sheet. The spec is background #ffffff, border-radius 12px, padding 12px, and shadow `rgba(0,0,0,0.22) 0px 16px 48px -8px`. Group labels ("PRODUCTS", "DOWNLOAD", "DEVELOPERS") are set in xVf 10px weight 500, uppercase, +0.5px tracking, #0a0a0a99. Items are xVf 14px weight 400 in #0a0a0a, spaced 24px apart, with external links marked by a small ↗ glyph. Groups are separated by 1px #0a0a0a0f rules. This is one of only two shadowed objects, and the elevation is earned because the menu genuinely floats over content.

### Announcement Pill

**Role:** Model-launch callout above headline

A frosted capsule. The spec is transparent background with backdrop-filter blur(4px), border 1px solid #0a0a0a14, border-radius 9999px, padding 6px 6px 6px 10px, 38px high, and xVf 13px weight 500 for "Meet Grok 4.7" with weight 400 #0a0a0a99 for "· Our new model". It leads with a "New" tag in #ff6308 on #ff63081a at radius 3px and padding 2px 6px. A 24px Fog Wash circle holding ↗ closes the pill. This is the single sanctioned home of Ember in the interface.

### Product Tile — Linen

**Role:** Main content card for each product

Borderless warm panel. The spec is background #f9f8f6, border-radius 16px, padding 0, measured at 403×280px in a 3-up row. The live mockup bleeds to the edges and is clipped by the radius. Footer labels sit 12px from the bottom edge: the product name in xVf 14px weight 500 #0a0a0a at left, and "Explore →" at right. Chat bubbles inside use Fog Wash with asymmetric radius 16px 16px 16px 6px, pointing the tail toward the speaker. The tile is a vitrine, and the mockup is the content.

### Terminal Tile — Onyx

**Role:** Inverted showcase for Build agent

Dark exhibit window. The spec is background #151515, border-radius 16px, inset highlight `rgba(255,255,255,0.03) 0px 1px 0px 0px inset`, and three 8px traffic-light dots (mockup-internal #ff5f57, #febc2e, #28c840). Text is GeistMono 11–13px in #e1e1e1 (mockup-internal), with green and red diff rows on #202a16 and #32181c (mockup-internal). Status brackets are set in GeistMono 700. It is the only dark rectangle above the fold, framed as a screenshot rather than a theme switch.

### Code Window on Ember Field

**Role:** Developer API sample showcase

Paper window on fire. A #ffffff panel with border 1px #d5d9e2 (mockup-internal), border-radius 12px and shadow `rgba(0,0,0,0.06) 0px 0px 0px 1px, rgba(15,23,42,0.18) 0px 18px 40px -24px` floats on a grainy gradient that runs from blush to #ff6308. The gradient is decorative, not a token, and is marked by four 8px white crop squares at its corners. Code is GeistMono 13px at 1.846, with syntax in #d73a49 and #24292e (mockup-internal). A "Copy" button in xVf 12px weight 500 sits top-right. The field is the one place the page allows color in volume.

### Language Tab Pills

**Role:** Switch code sample language

Soft segmented control. Each tab has border-radius 9999px, padding 6px 12px, 32px height, xVf 14px weight 500 and an 8px gap. The active tab gets background #0a0a0a14 with text #0a0a0a; inactive tabs are transparent with text #7d8187. It is the pill vocabulary at its lightest weight, with state carried entirely by an ink veil instead of the conventional underline or colored indicator.

### Stat Row

**Role:** Scale proof, three figures

Numbers as typography. A 3-column band is bounded top and bottom by 1px #0a0a0a0f rules, with 1px #0a0a0a0f vertical dividers and 40px padding. Figures ("400M+", "200K", "122") are xVf 48px weight 500, −0.48px tracking, #0a0a0a. Labels are xVf 13px weight 400 in #8d867e, 16px below. There are no icons, no cards and no color, and the deliberate restraint lets the magnitude of each figure do the persuading. A compact variant under the API copy uses 14px weight 500 figures over 10.5px #8d867e labels.

### News Card

**Role:** Latest posts, 4-up row

Image-led headline unit. An 8px-radius thumbnail (291×153px, no border, no shadow) sits above a meta line in xVf 12px: category in #0a0a0a weight 500, date in #8d867e, 8px apart. The title follows in xVf 16px weight 500, line-height 1.375, −0.16px tracking, #0a0a0a, with a trailing chevron. The card has no background and no padding. The thumbnails carry the only saturated photography outside the product tiles, which keeps the cards themselves achromatic.

### Plan Card with Outline Pill

**Role:** Self-serve versus sales path

Two Linen panels side by side. Each has background #f9f8f6, border-radius 16px, padding 40px and no shadow. The title is xVf 24px weight 500 (−0.24px), the lede is 16px weight 400 #59534d, and a 1px #0a0a0a0f rule separates the lede from the list. Check-list rows use a #8d867e check and 13px #0a0a0a text at 8px spacing. The left card ends in a full-width 40px Ink pill. The right card uses a transparent pill with 1px #0a0a0a14 border, radius 9999px and padding 10px 18px. Equal geometry presents the two plans as equally valid choices.

## Do's and Don'ts

### Do

- Set the hero headline in xVf weight 450 at 60px with −0.6px tracking and line-height 1.0 — the in-between weight is the signature, making the largest type the calmest element on screen.
- Keep every clickable control a 9999px pill and every container a 16px rectangle — the binary shape vocabulary tells the user what is action and what is frame without color.
- Fill the primary action with #0a0a0a and white 14px weight 500 text — off-black is the brand color here, and its contrast replaces a saturated CTA.
- Pair each Ink pill with a Fog Wash #0a0a0a0a pill at an 8px gap — the two-density pair is the standard action group in the hero, the API section and the nav.
- Separate surfaces by tone: #ffffff canvas, #f9f8f6 tiles, #151515 terminal — layering by temperature and value keeps shadows free for the two floating layers.
- Apply −1% tracking (−0.01em) to every xVf size from 16px to 60px — a proportional rule rather than a hand-tuned ramp, so new sizes inherit the system automatically.
- Confine saturated hues to the product interior: syntax highlighting, traffic lights, photography and the #ff6308 gradient field. Keeping the chrome achromatic is non-negotiable, because the mockups are the exhibits and the page is the gallery wall.

### Don't

- Don't bump the 60px headline to weight 600 or 700 out of habit — conventional SaaS heroes go bold, but here heaviness would flatten the quiet 450-to-500 ladder that carries hierarchy.
- Don't recolor the primary pill in #ff6308 because Ember is the "brand orange" — doing so spends the one-hue budget on chrome and breaks the rule that color lives only inside product screens.
- Don't wrap Linen tiles in 1px borders or 0 4px 12px shadows — the 1.5% step from #ffffff to #f9f8f6 is the entire separation mechanism, and frames turn the vitrines into widgets.
- Don't swap Fog Wash for an opaque grey like #f2f2f2 — the 4% ink veil must re-tint on Linen and on white, and an opaque fill reads cold against #f9f8f6.
- Don't introduce 8px-radius buttons or 24px-radius cards — the 9999px/16px binary is the shape grammar, and in-between radii blur action and container.
- Don't set paragraph text in GeistMono or system-ui — mono and native faces are reserved for code and mockups at 10–14px, and leaking them into marketing copy collapses the exhibit/frame distinction.
- Don't put a colored icon or gradient behind a stat figure — the 48px #0a0a0a numbers over #8d867e labels must stand on typography alone. Decoration would make the proof read as promotion, so color should never be added there.

## Imagery

Imagery is almost entirely product: live UI mockups (chat threads, a terminal agent, an expense-reconciliation bot, a Python sample) that bleed to the edges of 16px Linen or Onyx tiles with no inner frame. Photography appears in two places. The Imagine collage shows generated renders of a red-lit gamepad, a chrome robot and a sneaker, cropped into 8px-radius cells. The news thumbnails are saturated gradient cards with no border or shadow. The Voice tile holds a starfield glass orb at 50% radius with a layered inset highlight, which is decorative only. Icons are small ↗ and → glyphs and thin check marks in #8d867e, plus a detected CursorIcons16 glyph font inside mockups. The grainy Ember gradient behind the code window is decorative, not a system token. The narrative: the model's outputs are the art, and the site is the neutral mount.

## Layout

Content sits in a 1280px container (1232px usable after 24px gutters), with the hero copy constrained to 768px and paragraphs to 448px. The hero opens 148px below the fixed 64px white nav. It is centered: announcement pill, two-line 60px headline, 18px subline, and the Ink plus Fog pill pair. A 3-column product-tile row follows, then a 2-column row with the Imagine collage and the Voice orb. Sections then alternate between split layouts and full-width bands at a 96px rhythm. The API block puts text left and the code window right, followed by a 3-column stat band, a 4-column news row and a 2-column plan comparison, with 1px #0a0a0a0f rules marking transitions. There is no logo row or pricing grid. The nav carries the logo and six links on the left and two pills on the right. The footer pairs the logo and copyright with a 5-column 13px link grid behind a dotted divider. At 375px, set the hero at 30px and use a 64px section gap. Overall density: comfortable.

## Color Quarantine

The defining discipline is that saturated color is quarantined inside product mockups and is not allowed to stain the chrome around them. Terminal greens, syntax reds, traffic-light dots, the red-lit gamepad and the #ff6308 gradient field all live inside 16px or 12px frames. Outside those frames, the interface is #0a0a0a, its washes, and the warm-grey caption ramp. The rule breaks the moment a builder tints a heading, colors a link hover, adds a colored icon to the stat band, or makes Ember the CTA fill. Any of those moves turns the gallery wall into another exhibit. To extend the system, keep new color inside a framed surface and let the frame be Linen or Onyx. New UI states stay in the ink-alpha family at 4%, 6%, 8% or 60%. Ember appears outside a frame only as the 10% tag tint.

## Half-Step Weights

The type system works in increments of 50 weight units, not the conventional 400/600/700 ladder. Body copy is 400, UI labels and section heads are 500, and the 60px display drops back to 450. Hierarchy is carried by size steps of roughly a Major Third and by a uniform −1% tracking rule, not by stroke mass. Substituting a static font family that lacks 450 breaks it: the display snaps to 400 and looks thin, or to 500 and looks shouty. Adding a 700 heading anywhere breaks it outright. To extend, use a variable font, keep any new display size at 450 and any new heading at 500, and compute tracking as size × −0.01. GeistMono 700 stays reserved for terminal status tokens.

- **xAI** — Shares OpenAI's white canvas, black pill primary action and borderless product tiles. xAI adds a warm #f9f8f6 tile tone and a 450-weight display where OpenAI runs heavier headlines.
- **xAI** — Shares Vercel's Geist Mono technical voice, ink-alpha hairlines and black-on-white developer framing. xAI swaps Vercel's grid lines and dark-mode default for tonal Linen tiles on a light canvas.
